best_idea: Advance the logic deadline by the step length (not from now), skip only the draw, never a logic step, when more than one step is pending, and hand the renderer a 0..1 fraction to interpolate animation between steps.
decision_why: Keep the deadline clock, one-step-per-call rule, skip-draw threshold and 0..1 fraction; drop the sleep limiter and lockstep turn code, which the browser and our server already cover.
acceptance: Client: with a 50 ms step and 16 ms frames the fraction runs 0 to 1 across each step and never exceeds 1; after a 600 ms stall one step runs per call and draws are skipped until caught up. Server test: kill events happen only on server steps and a skipped client draw changes no server state.
